evidence.asset_checksum_scope: Full remote bytes were SHA-256 verified in original upload attempt receipts. For reused objects, this run binds their original byte proofs and separately checks current HEAD and anonymous range samples; current HEAD is not a fresh full-byte hash.

transport_validation.scope: Browser report fields checked against independent plan/policy; response bytes are not re-fetched here.

browser_evidence.viewer_build: SHA-256 of hosted_browser_check.mjs, which holds the page; map libraries come from the node_modules given

evidence.catalog_link_scope: Immutable product package catalog/collection/styles/docs only; the aggregate Portolan catalog is not deployed or checked by this per-product run. External assets with sole role 'source' are provenance references; their bytes and transport are not checked.
